challenge.heroic_1_1.desc: Hold Emberfall Ridge with cold alone. The rift has doubled its wards against you.
challenge.heroic_1_1.name: Frostbound
challenge.heroic_1_10.desc: Four towers stand and the vault is empty. Everything after this, the Maw pays for.
challenge.heroic_1_10.name: What You Were Given
challenge.heroic_1_2.desc: Arcane is the only damage that answers a ward, and every ward here is twice as thick. The vault is open; spend it well.
challenge.heroic_1_2.name: Ward Breaker
challenge.heroic_1_3.desc: Spire and cairn, nothing else, on a road that shares its air with a second lane.
challenge.heroic_1_3.name: Cold Sky
challenge.heroic_1_4.desc: Volt and cryo only. Chill them until they stop, then charge what is left.
challenge.heroic_1_4.name: Storm and Ice
challenge.heroic_1_5.desc: Flame and frost, and nothing between them. Let the reaction do the work.
challenge.heroic_1_5.name: Two Pillars
challenge.heroic_1_6.desc: A garrison, a flame and a frost. Blocking is the only armour you are given.
challenge.heroic_1_6.name: Hold the Line
challenge.heroic_1_7.desc: Only the Still and the Spire, against armour beaten to twice its thickness.
challenge.heroic_1_7.name: Rustwork
challenge.heroic_1_8.desc: Mortar, arbalest and cairn. Reach is the whole plan; nothing you build fires fast.
challenge.heroic_1_8.name: Siege Doctrine
challenge.heroic_1_9.desc: Flame, frost and arcane against the elites. They fall to reactions or they do not fall.
challenge.heroic_1_9.name: Thermal Shock

codex.title: Codex
damage.arcane.desc: Raw rift energy. Reduced by Ward. Applies Unravel, which makes everything else hit harder — and it is what every reaction deals.
damage.arcane.name: Arcane
damage.cryo.desc: Cold. Reduced by Ward. Applies Chill, which slows, and which becomes Freeze at full stacks.
damage.cryo.name: Cryo
damage.kinetic.desc: Bolts, shells and blades. Reduced by Armour and by nothing else, which makes it the answer to Ward and the wrong answer to a Golem. Applies Fracture, the one mark that never detonates.
damage.kinetic.name: Kinetic
damage.pyro.desc: Fire. Reduced by Ward. Applies Scorch, which burns over time and is half of Thermal Shock and Combustion.
damage.pyro.name: Pyro
damage.toxic.desc: Acid and spores. Reduced by Ward. Applies Corrode, which strips Armour and Ward away stack by stack.
damage.toxic.name: Toxic
damage.true.desc: Unreduced by anything. Rare on purpose: a damage type with no counter is a damage type with no decision in it.
damage.true.name: True
damage.volt.desc: Lightning. Reduced by Ward. Applies Charge, which lengthens chains and is half of Superconduct and Electrolysis.
damage.volt.name: Volt
difficulty.impossible.desc: 10 lives, a quarter more enemies and an extra elite wave.
difficulty.impossible.name: Impossible
difficulty.normal.desc: 20 lives. The stage as it was designed.
difficulty.normal.name: Normal
difficulty.relaxed.desc: 30 lives and half again the gold. No stars, no lockout, no shame.
difficulty.relaxed.name: Relaxed
difficulty.veteran.desc: 15 lives, tougher enemies and a tighter purse.
difficulty.veteran.name: Veteran
enemy.broodling.counter: It splits again when it dies. Kill it away from your leak point, or clear the Mother before her children reach the road.
enemy.broodling.name: Broodling
enemy.bulwark_golem.counter: Sixty armour at the front and ten behind. A placement puzzle, not a damage one: towers behind the road do six times the work.
enemy.bulwark_golem.name: Bulwark Golem
enemy.burrower.counter: Untargetable for one stretch of tunnel. Kill it before it goes under, or hold the exit — the twenty armour matters far less than the timing.
enemy.burrower.name: Burrower
enemy.carrier.counter: Flies, and drops a fresh enemy behind your front line on a timer. Killing it early is worth more than the bounty says.
enemy.carrier.name: Carrier
enemy.chitin_mother.counter: Dies into two Broodlings, which die into two Mites each. Splash or ground damage on the stretch where she falls, or you are fighting seven enemies.
enemy.chitin_mother.name: Chitin Mother
enemy.dread_wyrm.counter: Flies, saps towers, and cannot be frozen. Anti-air that does not rely on hard crowd control, and enough of it to finish before the wind-up lands.
enemy.dread_wyrm.name: Dread Wyrm
enemy.grendrix.counter: Swallows whatever is blocking it, so pull the rally flag back and it walks free while a Ranger Lodge fights from outside its reach. Below half it spits pools that hold your plots down.
enemy.grendrix.name: Grendrix, the Rift Maw
enemy.husk.counter: The reference enemy — whatever your board does, it does it to a Husk. Five armour is enough that pure Kinetic starts to feel it.
enemy.husk.name: Husk
enemy.ironclad_revenant.counter: Forty armour is a wall against Kinetic. Bring an element, or strip the armour first with Corrode or Superconduct.
enemy.ironclad_revenant.name: Ironclad Revenant
enemy.maw_spawn.counter: Boss-flagged, so freezing and stunning are off the table. Damage is the only answer, and it swallows what blocks it.
enemy.maw_spawn.name: Maw Spawn
enemy.mender.counter: Heals the two most hurt enemies near it. Kill priority: everything else on the board is standing back up while it lives.
enemy.mender.name: Mender
enemy.mite.counter: What is left after a Chitin Mother has been broken twice. Trivial alone, ruinous in a wave you have no splash for.
enemy.mite.name: Mite
enemy.nullifier.counter: Towers within four tiles fire a quarter slower. Forty ward on top, so it is exactly the escort you least want to shoot at with elements.
enemy.nullifier.name: Nullifier
enemy.phase_stalker.counter: Teleports two tiles forward on any hit over a hundred. Sustained chip beats burst here, and thirty ward means elements land soft.
enemy.phase_stalker.name: Phase Stalker
enemy.rift_bat.counter: Flies straight for the Core and ignores the road entirely. Needs towers that reach air, on the lane it actually takes.
enemy.rift_bat.name: Rift Bat
enemy.rift_sprout.counter: Does not move; it keeps making things that do. A stationary spawner is a second spawn point until it is dead.
enemy.rift_sprout.name: Rift Sprout
enemy.riftling.counter: Fast and frail, and it comes in numbers. Anything that covers the road answers it; nothing that only hits one enemy at a time does.
enemy.riftling.name: Riftling
enemy.rust_prelate.counter: An elite that heals what it escorts. The fight is the escort, not the Prelate: break the healing and the wave comes apart.
enemy.rust_prelate.name: Rust Prelate
enemy.sapper.counter: Reaching a plot shuts that tower down for eight seconds. It telegraphs first — that wind-up is the window, and it is the whole answer.
enemy.sapper.name: Sapper
enemy.shieldwright.counter: Hands out a hundred-and-twenty-point overshield every few seconds. Burst through the shield or kill the source; chip damage never catches up.
enemy.shieldwright.name: Shieldwright
enemy.standard_bearer.counter: Speeds up everything around it. The wave arrives sooner than your board expects, so take the Bearer first and the timing back.
enemy.standard_bearer.name: Standard Bearer
hero.kaelen.aether_bolt.desc: A bolt that unravels what it strikes.
hero.kaelen.aether_bolt.name: Aether Bolt
hero.kaelen.conduit_surge.desc: Nearby conduits fire faster for a while.
hero.kaelen.conduit_surge.name: Conduit Surge
hero.kaelen.desc: A warden who reads the flow and bends it.
hero.kaelen.name: Kaelen, Spire-Wright
hero.kaelen.ward_break.desc: Strips the ward from everything nearby.
hero.kaelen.ward_break.name: Ward Break

power.aether_siphon.desc: Detonate every status at once, whatever the cost.
power.aether_siphon.name: Aether Siphon
power.rally_banner.desc: Every soldier stands taller, and everything nearby comes to them.
power.rally_banner.name: Rally Banner
power.rift_seal.desc: The road closes. Whatever was walking it piles up against nothing.
power.rift_seal.name: Rift Seal
power.riftfall.desc: Call down a burning shard of the rift.
power.riftfall.name: Riftfall
power.stasis_field.desc: A field where everything slows and frost gathers.
power.stasis_field.name: Stasis Field
reaction.amplify.desc: Unravelling deepens whatever else has taken hold.
reaction.amplify.name: Amplify
reaction.combustion.desc: Corrosion ignites, and the fire spreads.
reaction.combustion.name: Combustion
reaction.electrolysis.desc: Charge arcs through corroded flesh to everything nearby.
reaction.electrolysis.name: Electrolysis
reaction.superconduct.desc: Chilled metal conducts. Armour and ward collapse.
reaction.superconduct.name: Superconduct
reaction.thermal_shock.desc: Fire meets ice. The shock bursts outward.
reaction.thermal_shock.name: Thermal Shock

tower.alchemists_still.desc: Eats armour and ward alike, and pays for itself doing it.
tower.alchemists_still.name: Alchemist's Still
tower.arbalest_post.desc: Reliable single-target fire. Hits ground and air alike.
tower.arbalest_post.name: Arbalest Post
tower.arbalest_post.perk.fracture: Every bolt splinters what it strikes.
tower.arc_net.desc: No aiming, no misses, no rest. This lane is handled.
tower.arc_net.name: Arc Net
tower.arc_net.perk.ground: Keeps a live floor of current under itself.
tower.arcane_spire.desc: Raw aether. Armour means nothing to it; ward means everything.
tower.arcane_spire.name: Arcane Spire
tower.arcane_spire.perk.deep_unravel: Unravelling deepens on what is already coming apart.
tower.bulwark_order.desc: Armoured to a fault. They pull the wave onto themselves and hold.
tower.bulwark_order.name: Bulwark Order
tower.bulwark_order.perk.reflect: Its soldiers turn part of every blow back.
tower.firestorm_cannon.desc: Shells that burst into fire and leave the ground burning.
tower.firestorm_cannon.name: Firestorm Cannon
tower.firestorm_cannon.perk.ground: Leaves the ground burning where it lands.
tower.flame_vent.desc: A short cone of fire. Stacks Scorch faster than anything else.
tower.flame_vent.name: Flame Vent
tower.frost_cairn.desc: Little damage. Everything nearby slows, and chills.
tower.frost_cairn.name: Frost Cairn
tower.gilded_alembic.desc: Less killing, more gold. A bet on surviving long enough to spend it.
tower.gilded_alembic.name: Gilded Alembic
tower.gilded_alembic.perk.gold: Every kill on the map pays a little more, whoever made it.
tower.glacier_heart.desc: Pulses of deep cold that lock enemies in place.
tower.glacier_heart.name: Glacier Heart
tower.glacier_heart.perk.pulse: Freezes everything in reach, on its own slow clock.
tower.mortar_emplacement.desc: Lobs shells over distance. Blind up close, devastating against a pack.
tower.mortar_emplacement.name: Mortar Emplacement
tower.mortar_emplacement.perk.blast_slow: The blast leaves the ground treacherous.
tower.plague_vat.desc: The dying pass it on. A dense wave strips itself bare.
tower.plague_vat.name: Plague Vat
tower.plague_vat.perk.spread: What it kills bursts, Corroding everything near it.
tower.plasma_lance.desc: A piercing beam that unravels everything in a line.
tower.plasma_lance.name: Plasma Lance
tower.plasma_lance.perk.pierce: The beam runs through everything in line.
tower.prism_tower.desc: Borrows the colours of its neighbours and fires them back.
tower.prism_tower.name: Prism Tower
tower.prism_tower.perk.refract: Hits harder for every other damage type landing nearby.
tower.pyroclast_vent.desc: Scorch spreads from the dying to everything around them.
tower.pyroclast_vent.name: Pyroclast Vent
tower.pyroclast_vent.perk.spread: What it kills sets its neighbours alight.
tower.ranger_lodge.desc: They block, but would rather shoot. Softer, and far more mobile.
tower.ranger_lodge.name: Ranger Lodge
tower.ranger_lodge.perk.mark: Marks what its soldiers strike — every tower hits it harder.
tower.repeater_battery.desc: Relentless fire that splinters armour for every other tower.
tower.repeater_battery.name: Repeater Battery
tower.repeater_battery.perk.rate: No trick — just no gap between shots.
tower.rime_spire.desc: Chill that eats armour, leaving the frozen ready to shatter.
tower.rime_spire.name: Rime Spire
tower.rime_spire.perk.sunder: Every stack of Chill strips armour as well as speed.
tower.siege_howitzer.desc: A shell heavy enough to stop a column where it stands.
tower.siege_howitzer.name: Siege Howitzer
tower.siege_howitzer.perk.pulse: Every few shells land as a hard stop.
tower.sniper_nest.desc: Map-wide reach. Punches through armour, one shot at a time.
tower.sniper_nest.name: Sniper Nest
tower.sniper_nest.perk.pierce: Half of any armour in the way counts for nothing.
tower.storm_pylon.desc: A storm that walks through a pack and leaves none of it standing.
tower.storm_pylon.name: Storm Pylon
tower.storm_pylon.perk.discharge: Charge at its cap detonates instead of fading.
tower.tesla_coil.desc: Current leaps from one body to the next, charging all of them.
tower.tesla_coil.name: Tesla Coil
tower.tesla_coil.perk.chain_reach: The arc reaches further between targets.
tower.void_obelisk.desc: Pulls the wave inward, into everything else you have built.
tower.void_obelisk.name: Void Obelisk
tower.void_obelisk.perk.pull: Drags what it hits back down the road.
tower.wardens_barracks.desc: Three soldiers who stand in the road. Time bought, not damage dealt.
tower.wardens_barracks.name: Warden's Barracks
